witness.branch: Official traffic-control device on a paved-road railway approach.
witness.reason: The paved-road crossing can include a specific official device governing the intended crossing, subject to provenance and instruction evidence.
required_context: Device identity, instruction and governed crossing movement; generic device presence does not establish a railway warning, gate or stop sign.
Do not presume a gate, railway warning, stop sign, train presence or unconditional stopping duty.
Establish placement or erection by a public authority or railroad, traffic purpose and relevant legal status; preserve the incomplete external legal-consistency references.
Establish railroad crossing geometry, vehicle clearance and exit space, included vehicle status and actual driver identity.
Identify the device, its actual instruction or indication, governed movement and indication history.
Official placement, legal status, instruction history and driver identity.
Record visibility or communication history and vehicle response without making observability an additional statutory prerequisite.
Supported crossing, vehicle clearances and exit space.
witness.subject_reason: Choose the supplied motor_vehicle_driver operating a qualifying ordinary motor vehicle under actual physical control.
